classificationSettings.risk.title: When is a student at risk?
classificationSettings.risk.hint: Configure direct rules. There are no points or hidden weighting.
classificationSettings.risk.highSummary: A student is High risk when any rule below is true
classificationSettings.risk.behaviourRul: More than {count} concerning behaviour records within the last {days} days.
classificationSettings.risk.busRule: More than {count} bus exceptions within the last {days} days.
classificationSettings.risk.mediumRule: They have 1–{behaviour} concerning behaviours or 1–{bus} bus exceptions within {days} days, and no High-risk rule applies.
classificationSettings.risk.noneRule: No recent concerning behaviour or bus exceptions, and Canvas average is not below the High-risk threshold.
classificationSettings.risk.behaviourCou: High risk when concerning behaviours exceed
classificationSettings.risk.busCount: High risk when bus exceptions exceed
classificationSettings.risk.canvasBelow: High risk when Canvas average is below (%)
classificationSettings.commendation.hint: Configure direct recognition rules. There is no score or weighting.
classificationSettings.commendation.rule: They have at least {positive} positive behaviour records within {days} days OR a Canvas average of at least {canvas}%, AND they have no more than {bus} bus exceptions during those {days} days.

transcript.calculationDescription: These formulas explain the values displayed above. Calculations use the underlying Canvas results, including years currently hidden by the display filter.
transcript.yearResultCalculationHelp: Semester 2 has double weight. If both semester results are unavailable, the explicit year result is used, followed by the available semester result.
transcript.creditCalculationHelp: A subject found in only one semester receives 0.5 credit; a subject covering both semesters or represented by a full-year result receives 1 credit.
transcript.annualGpaCalculationHelp: Each YR percentage is converted through the displayed 4.2 grading scale, then weighted by the subject's credit.
transcript.academicGpaCalculationHelp: The final Academic GPA is the simple average of all available annual GPAs from Grades 9 through 12.

reports.classes.settings.formula: Flagged rate = students needing support ÷ total students in the grade or class × 100.
reports.classes.settings.amberHint: Review signals with the responsible team.
reports.classes.settings.validation: Green must be at least 0%, and Amber must be higher than Green and no more than 100%.
reports.classes.settings.summary: Current rule — Green: up to {green}; Amber: above {green} through {amber}; Red: above {amber}. Select “How grouping works” to see the formula or adjust thresholds.
